component.name: plugview
component.summary: Plug in a capture card and play your console

description.p: plugview turns this screen into a monitor for your console. Plug in a USB capture card, connect a Switch, PlayStation, Xbox or Steam Deck to it, and play with its sound, at the card's full frame rate and with as little delay as the card allows.

ul.li: Opens straight to the picture, nothing to set up
Volume, screenshots, resolution and full screen in a controls bar that fades while you play
Tells you when the card has no signal, and what to check on your console
Stays in the tray and opens when a card is plugged in

description.p: Started from a terminal, plugview is also a command: plugview --list, plugview --measure.
plugview for Linux as a Flatpak.
The Linux preview becomes the full app: launcher, controls bar, screenshots, signal watch and tray.
